verdicts.reason: A pushes the maroon panel into the top half (y≈95–470), leaving the lower ~40% as unframed photo with the slash and circle marks floating loose. The X is jammed into the top-left corner, so the layout is lopsided and the decorations no longer frame the text block the way they do in the original. B centres the panel vertically, so the X, slashes and circle sit around it more like the original corner framing. Its weaknesses are a short, dense headline block that leaves a lot of empty maroon inside the panel, and decorations that are still unevenly spaced: the top-right slash is missing and the lower slash and circle crowd the bottom-right.
